_comment: Model prices in USD per 1M tokens, substring-matched against a run's
model string (first hit wins). Loaded automatically by
Why this file is committed: a published cost figure must be traceable
to the rates it was computed with. Bump 'as_of' whenever you edit.
Entries with a null 'in' are IGNORED by the loader and the affected
runs are reported as 'unpriced:<model>' rather than silently costed
with a guessed rate. Fill these in from the provider's current price
page before the campaign so ursa/dspy/cursor cells get dollars.
_sources: and a pricing round-up (cached rate). Confirm against your own OpenAI billing
page before publishing a cost figure.
CAVEAT: the cursor cell runs gpt-5.2 through the Cursor CLI, which may bill at
its own rate. Its dollar figure is an OPENAI-RATE ESTIMATE from token counts,
not Cursor's actual charge — label it as derived, not measured, in the paper.
